plugins.name: pixel-review
plugins.description: Visual regression gate for agentic UI changes. Captures baseline screenshots before an agent edits UI code, captures again after, and runs a stdlib PNG diff (per-region diff percentages, highlighted diff image) that blocks done claims when the diff exceeds a threshold in unintended regions. Caveat: pixel comparison of compressed or complex PNGs is approximate; the gate also asks for an agent-side visual review of the diff image before accepting a pass.
